calibrate.description: Set the steering centre and the pedal travel. Values come from the board; Save writes them back.
calibrate.emptyError: Every field must have a value.
calibrate.invalidNumber: Enter a valid number for every field.
calibrate.minMaxError: Each pedal's minimum must be below its maximum.
calibrate.rangeError: Values must be between 0 and 3300 mV.
calibrate.title: Calibrate

connect.description: Pick how the app talks to the board, then connect. Wi-Fi uses the board hotspot or your network; USB uses a serial cable.
connect.polling: Waiting for the wheel to connect…
connect.title: Connect

setup.doneMessage: Your wheel is set up. You can revisit any step from the Setup screen at any time.

finish.description: Review what is done. Anything skipped can be finished later from this screen.
finish.finished: Setup finished. The Dashboard is ready to use.
finish.revisit: You can come back to Setup from the sidebar at any time.
finish.title: Finish

firmware.description: Upload a signed firmware image. The signature is checked before anything is uploaded — an unsigned, tampered, or older image can never reach the board.
firmware.downgrade: Version {{version}} is older than the installed {{current}} — upload blocked.
firmware.invalid: This image failed validation. Upload stays disabled.
firmware.pickerUnavailable: The file picker is not available in this build — type the firmware path instead.
firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.unknownVersion: Unknown — the backend did not report a version yet
firmware.uploadDisabled: Upload is disabled until the image passes validation and is not a downgrade.
firmware.uploaded: Firmware uploaded. The board will restart — reconnect and check the version.

setup.notImplemented: Not available yet — the backend has not implemented this feature. Nothing was changed.

pairing.description: Pairing opens a 60-second window and shows a one-time device password. Save it somewhere safe — the board will ask for it when you connect.
pairing.hidden: Password hidden. It was shown once and will not be shown again in this session.
pairing.noSpaces: Type the password without spaces — the spaces shown here are only for readability.
pairing.shownOnce: Shown once only — write it down now. This password will not be shown again.
pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.windowOpen: A pairing window is already open.

password.description: Change the device password used when pairing. It must be 8 to 63 printable characters.
password.invalidChars: Use printable characters only (letters, digits, symbols).
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.title: Change password
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

pins.description: The GPIO pin map on the board. This view is read-only here — pins are edited in Settings.
pins.title: Pins

setup.subtitle: Connect your wheel, pair it, set your pins and calibration, and check firmware — one step at a time.
setup.title: Setup wizard
